task: Scaffold a small multi-file React playground app for testing the Command Code memory mods (task-journal, project-brain), with pnpm, shared UI components, Tailwind CSS, header/footer nav, and mobile responsiveness.
summary: Created memory-test-app/, a Vite 8 + React 19 + Tailwind v4 + react-router 8 app with shared Button/Card/Badge primitives, an AppLayout with sticky Header and Footer nav, three pages, a build that passes tsc + vite, and a dev server smoke test that served HTML and SPA routes.

approaches.description: Hand-scaffolded the app file-by-file instead of using a boilerplate generator, choosing latest versions from the pnpm registry (React 19, Vite 8, Tailwind 4, react-router 8).
Centralized nav items in src/lib/nav.ts shared by Header and Footer.

solution: Built the app by hand: config files (package.json with build = 'tsc --noEmit && vite build', vite.config.ts with react() + tailwindcss() plugins, strict tsconfig, index.html), Tailwind v4 styling via @theme brand tokens in src/index.css, shared UI primitives in src/components/ui/, layout components in src/components/layout/, and three pages wired into a BrowserRouter tree in main.tsx; then installed with pnpm and verified with a production build plus a dev-server curl smoke test.

tests.command: pnpm install --dir memory-test-app && pnpm --dir memory-test-app build

lesson: The strict tsconfig (noUnusedLocals) makes the type-check gate fail on unused imports, so run `pnpm build` after any edit before claiming the app is green; curl smoke tests against the Vite dev server must wait for the server to be ready before asserting routes return 200.

task: Create two probe files and run a Project Brain discovery pass over the mod sources
summary: Created memory-test-app/PROBE-A.md and PROBE-B.md with one line 'probe' each, then inspected the mods and README to store 5 new durable facts about the repo (mod architecture, flag namespacing, cmd.events cooperation, React Router layout, colors helper).

approaches.description: Wrote the two probe files first with parallel write_file calls
Ran the discovery pass by reading mod sources and README, then emitting the JSON facts array

solution: Parallel file writes plus a read-only inspection of .commandcode/mods/ and README to ground each stored fact in concrete source evidence.
lesson: Facts should cite 1-3 real source files with observed evidence, never repeat already-injected facts, and stay in present tense with namespaced mod flags and cross-mod cmd.events cooperation as the key durable invariants.

task: Run a full recolor pass on the memory-test-app React/Tailwind surface
summary: Rebuilt the color system in OKLCH with semantic role tokens (canvas/surface/ink/line/focus/accent/state colors) and remapped every component and page off stone-* grays onto those roles; build passes.

approaches.description: Define semantic role tokens + OKLCH brand ramp in the @theme block, then remap every component to role classes
Grep for remaining stone-* references and run pnpm build to verify tokens compile

solution: Centralized the whole palette in index.css @theme (Tailwind v4 takes oklch() values directly), kept the brand green but rebuilt it at H 150 with chroma clamped at the extremes, tinted neutrals toward the brand hue, and swapped every stone-* utility for semantic tokens (text-ink/ink-muted, bg-canvas/surface, border-line, outline-focus, accent-*/state tokens).
lesson: Tailwind v4 @theme accepts oklch() tokens directly and generates utilities like text-ink and bg-canvas from --color-* names, so a recolor is one CSS edit plus class remaps, verified by a stone- grep and tsc --noEmit via pnpm build.

task: Add a decisions array to the task-journal episode schema so key choices (with rationale and rejected alternatives) are captured, stored, and rendered alongside approaches
summary: Extended the task-journal mod with decisions: [{choice, reason?, rejected?}] — schema, extraction prompt, normalization, injection block, /journal show, and durable-fact graduation — verified end to end with headless probes.

approaches.description: Added Decision interface and decisions: Decision[] to TaskEpisode, then parsed raw.decisions in normalizeEpisode (capped at 8)
Extended the extraction prompt with a decisions bullet + JSON example so the cheap model emits choices with reason and rejected
Verified via headless cmd -p probe runs; the single-file probe hit the meaningful-run gate and did not journal, the two-file probe produced a real decisions entry

solution: Wired decisions end to end in task-journal.ts: Decision interface, extraction prompt, normalizeEpisode, renderEpisodeForModel ('Key decisions'), renderEpisodeDetail, task_journal_search description, and the durable-fact emit now triggers on episode.lesson || episode.decisions.length with the first decision promoted as fact text when no lesson exists; README updated throughout.
lesson: The meaningful-run gate (≥2 files changed, or 1 file + a test) means a single-file probe never triggers journal extraction — when verifying a schema change, change ≥2 files in the probe and restore the git-tracked JSONL stores afterward.

task: Add injection-announcements so the memory mods notify and list exactly which facts/episodes they inject into the prompt
summary: Wired cmd.ui.notify + cmd.showEntry into both mods' appendSystemPrompt, announcing injected items once per task with a feed entry listing each fact/episode; verified via cmd mods list and headless probes.

approaches.description: Stash the picked facts/episodes in closure vars inside buildInjectedBlock and announce from appendSystemPrompt
approaches.reason: buildInjectedBlock already computes the pick, so the announce sees exactly what was injected

approaches.description: Guard the announce with a per-task key (announcedPromptKey) reset on onRunEnd/onSessionStart
approaches.reason: appendSystemPrompt fires per round; without the guard the notify would spam every round

approaches.description: Register a cmd.addRenderer for each custom entry type so showEntry renders styled lines
Probe the journal announce headless with a matching prompt
approaches.reason: transformInput never fires in -p mode, so currentTask stays empty and the journal injects nothing headless

decisions.choice: Announce from appendSystemPrompt only when a non-empty block was injected
decisions.reason: a notify should only claim injection when something was actually injected

decisions.choice: Use currentTask||latestUserPrompt as the announce key for the journal
decisions.reason: same key that keeps the retrieval block byte-stable, so announce and injection stay in sync

solution: Both mods now stash injected items, notify 'brain/journal: N relevant fact(s)/episode(s) injected' once per task, and showEntry a detailed feed row via a registered renderer; README documents the new surface.
lesson: The journal injects (and now announces) nothing in headless -p mode because transformInput doesn't fire there and currentTask stays empty — only the brain's confidence fallback makes it announce headless; the announce guard must reset on onRunEnd or the next task never re-announces.

task: Add relative-date rendering to the brain and journal list output, with a 3-day const window
summary: Added RELATIVE_DAYS = 3 const and an identical formatDate() helper to both memory mods, so /brain and /journal list rows show 'x mins/hrs/days ago' for recent entries and fall back to the full YYYY-MM-DD date beyond 3 days.

approaches.description: Added a module-level RELATIVE_DAYS = 3 const plus a formatDate(iso) helper to each mod
approaches.reason: keeps the 3-day threshold a named constant and gives one canonical place for the relative logic

approaches.description: Wired formatDate into listFactsMessage/listEpisodesMessage replacing createdAt/completedAt.slice(0, 10)
Duplicated the helper inside each mod instead of lifting it into colors.ts
approaches.reason: colors.ts stays purely the ANSI styling lib; each mod stays self-contained for list formatting

decisions.choice: Duplicate the identical helper in both mods rather than sharing it
decisions.reason: matches the existing colors.ts convention of a tiny shared lib only for styling, keeps each mod independently readable

decisions.choice: Window of RELATIVE_DAYS = 3, then fall back to full date
decisions.reason: the user asked for recent relative + older full-date with a const threshold

solution: Both mods now have RELATIVE_DAYS = 3 and formatDate() (sub-hour → mins ago, sub-3-day → hrs ago, else days ago within the window, else YYYY-MM-DD), used in both list renderers.
lesson: Keep the date-window threshold a named const (RELATIVE_DAYS) and clamp sub-minute ages to '1 min ago' so list rows never print '0 mins ago' or crash on an unparseable ISO date.

task: Improve memory retrieval relevance and fix journal feedback attribution
summary: Replaced substring overlap scoring with exact-token, weighted-field, rarity, phrase, threshold, and diversity ranking in both memory mods, and repaired the journal feedback loop

approaches.description: Deterministic lexical upgrade: exact tokens, weighted fields, rarity, phrase/path bonuses, thresholds, duplicate suppression
Fixed the journal feedback defect by populating retrievedEpisodeIds on automatic injection
Damped feedback into a capped multiplier and replaced the 30-day discount with gradual recency decay
Synchronized README retrieval documentation and verified with mods list, pnpm build, and diff --check

decisions.choice: Improve deterministic retrieval rather than adding a per-task LLM reranker
decisions.reason: keeps selection fast, inspectable, and zero-dependency; a reranker remains a deferred optional phase
decisions.rejected: Semantic embeddings or a model call for every task

decisions.reason: those fields hold the reusable experience and were previously invisible to retrieval
decisions.rejected: Restricting ranking to task, summary, and file paths

decisions.choice: Require a minimum relevance signal and apply duplicate suppression
decisions.reason: avoids injecting near-identical facts/episodes and generic one-token matches
decisions.rejected: Injecting any item with a nonzero overlap

decisions.choice: Make feedback a capped small multiplier after at least three retrievals
decisions.reason: prevents one successful task from dominating topical relevance

solution: Introduced shared-style exact-token ranking in both mods, weighted field scoring (Brain: keyword/path/fact/evidence; Journal: task/summary/solution/lesson/decision/approach/test/path), IDF-like rarity, phrase and path bonuses, minimum-score gates, near-duplicate suppression, and gradual recency decay; fixed retrievedEpisodeIds population, added capped feedback, and updated the README to describe the deterministic retrieval behavior.
lesson: Deterministic lexical retrieval with exact tokens, weighted fields, rarity, thresholds, and diversity closes most relevance gaps without a model call; keep feedback bounded and fix attribution wiring before trusting the journal's success signal.

task: Improve task-journal retrieval relevance to match project-brain's selection quality
summary: Unified journal retrieval behind a single rankEpisodes() selector with outcome-quality weighting, ingestion-time duplicate rejection, latest-prompt retrieval, and feedback attribution for task_journal_search; README and comments updated.

approaches.description: Centralized ranking into one rankEpisodes() helper reused by injection, /journal search, and task_journal_search
approaches.reason: every surface now shares the same threshold, sort, and near-duplicate suppression

approaches.description: Added outcomeMultiplier (success 1.0 / partial 0.85 / failed 0.7) applied before bounded feedback and recency decay
approaches.reason: successful episodes outrank failed ones even before feedback accumulates

approaches.description: Rejected exact normalized duplicate episodes at ingestion with a warning notify
Keyed retrieval and the announce guard to latestUserPrompt and attributed task_journal_search results to retrievedEpisodeIds
approaches.reason: multi-turn prompt changes re-rank and manual lookups train feedback

decisions.choice: Keep deterministic lexical retrieval rather than adding embeddings or an LLM reranker
decisions.rejected: semantic embeddings or a per-task model reranker

decisions.choice: Do not add brain-style source hashing or stale invalidation to episodes
decisions.reason: episodes are historical experience; recency decay plus the historical warning is the right policy
decisions.rejected: source-file hashing and active/stale status for the journal

solution: Implemented rankEpisodes() as the single selector (score, threshold, sort, diversity), outcomeMultiplier before feedback/recency, isDuplicateEpisode() exact-normalized dedupe at ingest, latestUserPrompt-based caching and announcements, and retrievedEpisodeIds attribution in task_journal_search; updated README and source comments to match.
lesson: When edit_file keeps rejecting multi-line replacements due to whitespace normalization, fall back to exact single-line anchors or a small Python patch script against the already-read file.
